articles.title: Persistence & Retention
articles.summary: This report series helps institutions understand first-year college persistence and retention patterns and identify disparities between different students, institutions, or states in this important early success indicator.
articles.author: NSC Research Center

articles.title: Clearinghouse Final Spring Enrollment Trends
articles.summary: The Final Spring Enrollment Trends report, published each June, provides comprehensive national spring enrollment estimates by credential type, institutional sector, enrollment intensity, student demographics, major field, and state.
articles.author: NSC Research Center
